{{Top|leg}}
'''Electrogravitic gyro flywheels''' were units that allowed [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeders]] to make sharp banks, turns, and drops. [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Simon Greyshade/Legends|Simon Greyshade]] used them in his personal [[XJ-6 airspeeder/Legends|XJ-6 airspeeder]].
